title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.64
subtitle: AETHER: Wind, cleaner starts, a freer Grab.

highlights.title: Wind for AETHER
highlights.description: Force Empties blow the cloth in Live and in bakes: speed, gusts, turbulence and the same air field as the Wind preview.

highlights.title: Grab Cloth
highlights.description: No stretch limit: the cloth follows as far as you pull, and no vertices stay stuck on the body afterwards.

highlights.title: Fewer crossed layers
highlights.description: Cloth is moved ahead of a moving arm or leg before it gets caught, so fast motion leaves fewer layers crossed.

highlights.title: Clean starts
highlights.description: Cloth that starts inside the body is pulled out in more cases, and Start from Fit Pose begins a bake from the pose the garment was made for.

highlights.title: Water settings
highlights.description: GAIA Water Flow and TETHYS Wetness can stay on; the AETHER Engine simply ignores them.
